conditions: CPU resource-metrics API uses its own sample timestamp and averaging window; dashed CPU is cAdvisor rate[1m] backfill. Never sum these sources. Arrivals count observed attempt_start, including retries, in UTC-aligned 10s bins; edge bins can be partial.
gap_policy: Dense observer/replica samples disconnected after 20s; CPU API after 90s; cAdvisor after 15s. No extrapolation beyond last sample. Missing data never becomes zero.
